notes: GenApp's VSAM 'update customer' (LGUCVS01, LINKed by LGUCDB01): EXEC CICS READ FILE('KSDSCUST') INTO(WS-Customer-Area) LENGTH(WS-Commarea-Len = EIBCALEN) RIDFLD(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) KEYLENGTH(10) UPDATE, then REWRITE FROM(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) LENGTH(225). Each scenario's KSDSCUST is compared after the task. Every non-NORMAL RESP in this program goes to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, whose first act is EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('LGSTSQ') (GenApp's TS/TD error logger, defined in the CSD); the equivalence harness runs one program and has no port of LGSTSQ, so a scenario that reaches it is refused (Unsupported: LINK PROGRAM(LGSTSQ)). The error paths -- NOTFND on the READ (CA-RETURN-CODE '81', ABEND LGV1) and a failing REWRITE ('82', ABEND LGV2) -- are therefore NOT exercised here; they need LGSTSQ modelled (or ported) first. The READ's LENGTH (EIBCALEN, 32500 here) is not modelled by the stub (it reads LENGTH OF INTO); with a 225-byte record and a 1024-byte INTO area no LENGERR could arise either way. Keys: PIC 9(10), digits only; no browse. Data: ksdscust.txt as in genapp-lgacvs01 (GenApp's db2cre.jcl sample customers).
